title: Trunk Uplink
lesson: Trunk ports carry multiple VLANs (802.1Q). In this trainer, marking a switchport as trunk relaxes single-VLAN matching so it can uplink to the firewall LAN handoff — the same idea as a tagged uplink in Packet Tracer labs.
brief: Set Gi1/0/8 to trunk mode and patch it to FW-EDGE LAN0. Prove the uplink is up.
